Dialogs.Dialog: It's me. Can you talk right now？
Yes, it's your Manaka. Just kidding.
Haha, there's something I want to talk about.
Hello. Somehow I had a feeling you'd call.
That's amazing. Then maybe you even know what it's about？
Hehe, not quite that much... What is it？
Hello. Hehe, I was just wanting to hear your voice.
Looks like I called at the right time.
Did you want to hear my voice too？ Just kidding.
It's me. Is now a good time to talk？
Something to talk about？ Sure, go ahead.
There's something I want to talk about, is that okay？
Yeah. Do you have time right now？
What is it？ It's fine if it's quick.
You sound kind of down？ Should I call back？
It's fine. If you need something, I'll hear it now.
Want to stop by ▲デート場所▲ on the way home today？
Of course. I'll look forward to it.
I don't think I can make it... sorry.
Hmm... I don't think I can.
Sorry, and you went to the trouble of asking me.
Today's not good for me. Could we make it another day？
Yeah, sure. I'll get in touch again.
The waiting is part of the fun of a date, isn't it？
It gets you all excited, huh.
Then it's decided. Don't break your promise, okay？
Thank you for asking me. See you.
Um... don't break your promise again, okay？ I'll be waiting.
Last time fell through... so to make up for it, I want you to spoil me on our next date.
Yeah, got it. Sorry about last time.
We'll really meet this time, right？ If you break your promise, there's a punishment.
Yeah, I promise. I won't break it this time...
With this, maybe I'll forgive you for ignoring me last time.
Don't leave me all alone this time, okay？ That kind of thing... makes me sad.
Sorry, I didn't mean anything by it...
Don't go home and leave me behind again, okay？ Promise？
Yeah, I won't do that again...
It's been a while since I wrote a date in my planner.
Yeah... sorry, we haven't been seeing each other lately.
Thank you for seeing me. I thought maybe you'd gotten tired of me...
You thought that？ Sorry, it's been hard for us to meet lately.
You know. You haven't been taking me on dates at all lately, so I was lonely, you know？
Sorry, a lot has been going on...
Are you free the evening of ▲月▲▲日▲？ Want to go on a date at ▲デート場所▲？
I'm so happy... Of course I'll go. It'll be a wonderful date.
Did you get it just for me？ Just kidding. Of course I'll go.
My schedule is... fine. I can go.
Thanks for asking, but that day doesn't work.
Hmm, not really... I think I'll pass this time.
It's fine. I'll think of something else. Bye.
I'd like to go, but I have plans. Can we make it another day？
It's decided. My heart's already racing.
Let's make it a great date！
Hehe, I might not hear a word of class that day.
Haha, I'm not so sure about me either.
Now there's something to look forward to after school.
Feels like even class will be fun.
Thank you for calling. I was so happy it surprised me.
I'll get in touch again. Bye.
I'm really happy you asked me. Thank you.
Hello. Is it okay to call right now？
It's Manaka. Um, is now okay？
It's me. Hey, got a minute？
I'd be happy if we could go on a date after school today... what do you think？
Are you free today？ I wanted to go on a date after school.
I was hoping we could go on a date on the way home today. What are your plans？
Then after school, at the school gate.
Yeah！ I hope class ends fast.
Thank you. I'm looking forward to it.
Me too. See you after school at the gate.
Then let's meet at the school gate.
Got it. Can't wait for after school.
Um... actually, can we call it off this time？
Sorry. I know it's bad, but can I cancel？
Yes, let's make it that day.
Hey, can we make it a different day？
You want to see me that much？ ...Me too, though.
Geez, how many times is this？ But okay.
Again？ But I want to see you too.
Okay. But this is the last time, okay？ Just kidding.
Okay. ...Are we seeing each other too much？
We were just together, and again？ You're impossible.
Then let's meet at ▲デート場所▲ right now.
We haven't made plans like this much lately... See you soon.
So, ▲デート場所▲ right now, okay？
Okay. ...I'm glad, we get to see each other for the first time in a while.
Then let's meet at ▲デート場所▲. I'll be right there.
It's been a while... meeting up like this.
Sorry. But it's just that I want to see you that much.
Geez... think about how I feel too...
I am. That's exactly why I want to meet and talk in person.
Don't you get that I said no？
I get it... but please, think about it.
That's fine, I'll be waiting. Bye.
...There's no guarantee I'll actually come, you know？
I'm going. See you later... if you come.
I'll think about it, but the answer might be no.
It's me... Hey, can we meet now？ Just your voice isn't enough...
Fine if it's not right now
It's Manaka. ...I want to see you, right now. Can't I？
I want to see you！ Right now, okay？
Can it be a bit later？
Let's see, how about ▲デート場所▲？ I'll head there now.
Sorry for the short notice. But I really wanted to see your face...
That's what being a boyfriend is all about.
Got it. ▲デート場所▲ okay？ I'll be right there.
Thank you, I'm so happy... I'll be right there too.
Okay. Hey, I want to see you soon...
That kind of selfishness is more than welcome. See you.
All right. See you at ▲デート場所▲ at ▲時刻▲.
Thank you. I pushed you into it...
Don't worry, I wanted to see you too.
Sorry. Now's not a great time.
No. I want to see you...
I see... I put you on the spot. I'm sorry too.
Even if you say that... I can't manage it.
Don't worry about it. See you.
I'm the one who should be sorry. Bye.
You're in a good mood. What's up？
Hello, it's Manaka. Is now okay to talk？
It's Manaka. Is now okay to talk？
It's Manaka. Is it... okay to talk？
I just wanted to say thank you... Thank you for planning such a wonderful date.
No need to thank me. I'm looking forward to it too.
But you thought about it a lot and prepared it, right？ Wasn't it hard？
Not really. I just want ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to enjoy it without worrying about anything.
Geez, you're so cool. Okay... I'll look forward to it.
What's this, all of a sudden？
For the date. You planned it for me, right？
If it makes ▲高嶺＊＊▲ happy, it's no big deal.
No. Thank you, again. I'll say it as many times as I want.
Thank you for going out with me.
When I was thinking about the date you asked me on, I felt like saying it.
You're that excited about it？ Then it was worth asking.
I'll do my best too, so let's make it the best date ever.
Thinking about the date made me want to hear your voice...
Hehe, that's how much I'm looking forward to it. I wish the day would come already.
Now, now, let's just look forward to it and wait.
Right... this is kind of part of the date too.
I was looking at my calendar and thought of our date.
Yeah. I hope the day comes soon.
I feel the same... I even put a special sticker on the day, different from our usual dates.
Haha, doing that won't make it come any faster, you know？
I know... I know, but I did it anyway.
You can't wait that much？ Haha, I'm happy.
For our date... what kind of outfit do you think would be good？
Because my heart feels full even before we go！
No need to rush, we still have time. Take your time deciding.
Yes... right. Then I'll keep it a surprise for the day... Just kidding.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
I want to go on our date soon...
Let's have our date already. Hey, hurry, hurry.
Huh!? Um... even if you say that.
Hehe, just kidding. I wanted to see you flustered... Just kidding.
I'm looking forward to our date. I can't wait.
You know. I feel so happy right now.
I see... dates are great, huh.
I'm sure I feel this happy because it's with you.
(...Now I really have to make this date great.)
Our next date... is special, right？
Look who's talking, your voice is bouncing.
Ah... you can tell, huh. That's why I called...
Let's make it a fun date, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It looks like it'll be cloudy on the day of our date.
I see. I hope it doesn't rain.
Maybe I should make a teru teru bozu...
...It's fine. If I make one ahead of time, I won't have to worry even if it rains, right？
Is that how it works？ Oh well. I'm counting on it, then.
Did you see the weather forecast？ It says it'll rain on the day of our date...
Hmm, should we change the day...
But... I've been looking forward to it for so long.
Even so. Wouldn't a date on a sunny day be better？
It'll be fine！ It won't rain, I'm sure.
...I see. If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ says so, I'll believe it.
Have you decided what time you'll go to sleep tonight？
We have a date tomorrow, right？ I'm worried I won't be able to sleep... if you're still up, I might call you.
You can call anytime. But I think you should get to bed early？
Right... I have to sleep like usual. I don't want to doze off during our date.
Haha, right. I'll go to bed early tonight too.
Of course！ Don't worry, I've been looking forward to it too.
Right. Tomorrow is our special day... Just kidding.
Exactly. Let's make it a special day.
...Yes. Right. Let's make it a special day.
Tomorrow's the day. I've been having a staring contest with my calendar, you know？ But that ends today♪
...Then, shall we postpone it a bit？
...If you're going to be mean, I'll cancel.
Sorry, sorry！ I won't say it again！
Just to make sure. What day is tomorrow？
Our date is tomorrow. I can look forward to it, right？
You can. I've been looking forward to it too.
Our date is finally tomorrow. I wish it would hurry up...
Haha, you're restless. I can hear it in your voice.
I wonder how today's date will go？
That's a surprise for when we meet.
Hey, it's today... I always get restless before a date.
Our date is today. I've been waiting for this day forever▼
Thinking about our date, I can't focus on studying... even though it's still days away.
I'm about the same. Maybe we should've picked an earlier day.
I was wondering what you're up to. I can't stop thinking about our next date...
It's still days away, so there's no point getting worked up now. Right？
There's still time before our date, right？ So I thought I'd recharge by hearing your voice.
My voice recharges you？ You can hear it as much as you want.
Hey, you know why I called, right？
Then, what will you do next？
Good. You don't seem to be hurt or sick.
Then why are you late？ What's the reason？
Um... sorry, I'll be right there！
(Making her wait this long is a total boyfriend fail, me！)
I've been waiting a long time now...
Yes. If you don't come soon, I'm going home.
(Her tone being so normal makes her sound even angrier...)
You don't know how I felt, waiting... do you？
Um... I'm sorry for being late.
There's still time, but... should we just call off today's date？
Did I do something wrong？ I waited all that time...
Sorry... it's my fault. I'm really sorry.
Why didn't you come？ Does that mean our promise doesn't matter to you？
What now？ I'm still free, but...
Let's still go on our date. It might be selfish... but I want a chance to make up for it.
...Okay. I want to see you too, after all.
Thanks. Then, at the place we agreed on！
Can't we still have our date？ Ending it like this would be way too awkward...
Right... okay. Then I'll head over now？
I'll be right there too. I'll make it a fun date, I promise！
Let's meet now！ I'll make it a fun date... please！
...If you put it that way, I'll forgive you. Should I head over now？
Yeah. Thanks, I'll be right there too.
Yeah, let's call it off. I'll make it up to you, I promise.
Okay... I'll be waiting for you to make it up to me.
I won't keep you waiting next time.
Let's call it off. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ isn't in a date mood either, right？
Sorry about today. Let's start over and have a proper date next time.
Fine. I'll make some other plans for today...
I'll never do this again. I'll get in touch.
You broke your promise again... Why didn't you come today？
I don't want excuses. Just say "I'm sorry" properly.
...Okay. Then I'll forget about this time.
If I can't hear it, it doesn't count as an apology, you know？ Come on, "I'm sorry."
You didn't come on our date today. I don't like people who break promises.
I'm sorry！ It wasn't on purpose！
I'm not angry. I was sad. Please, don't make me feel like this again...
Okay. I won't do it again...
Hey, could it be you're mad at me？
Just... the way you've been acting lately, somehow.
Sorry for making you lonely. Next time I'll be the one to call.
Okay... but, not just your voice...
I know. I need to make time to see you properly too.
Then, want to meet now？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲, what are your plans？
That's not true, is it？ Isn't it just your imagination？
Is it？ ...Sorry, I'll calm down and think it over again...
I'll think about it a bit too.
How are you feeling？ I'm calling to check you're resting properly.
Of course I'll worry... If it seems okay to visit, I'm coming over.
Don't push yourself, only if you can make it. Thanks.
Are you feeling okay？ If there's anything I can do, just tell me, okay？
Just you saying that gives me plenty of energy. Thanks.
Then I'm glad I called. I'll visit if I can.
I'll lie around and wait for you.
Um... did you have fun on our date？
Because I got so caught up in it... I wondered if I was the only one having fun...
No need to worry. I had fun too.
Thank you for being such a gentlemanly escort on our date.
You're welcome. Did you have fun？
Of course. Maybe next time I'll escort you... Just kidding.
Sounds good. Ask me once you have a plan.
Thank you for such a fun time on our date.
You're welcome. I had fun too.
Dates are funny. Even places I've been before feel completely different when I go with you.
That's interesting. If there are other places you want to go, let me know.
Yeah, I had fun too. I hope we can have another date like that.
So impatient, already talking about the next one？ But... I want to go on another date too. Right away, if I could.
When I think back on our date, my heart still races... How about you？
Now that ▲高嶺＊＊▲ said that, my heart's starting to race.
Hehe, maybe I'll make it race even more... I love you▼
Haha... I'm happy, but have mercy...
Oh, a pretty high score. But 10 points short...
Thank you for the date... I was so moved.
Thank you too. I feel great too.
I'm sad that the afterglow is fading... I wish I could lock this feeling in, just like this...？
You don't need to do that. I'm sure there are even more fun things ahead.
...Right, together we can surely find even more.
Thank you for the date... my heart is still tingling.
I tried pretty hard on this date. I'm glad you liked it.
I'm sure a lot will happen to us from now on. We might even fight... but you know？
If I remember what I felt on this date, I feel like we can get through anything. That's what I think.
That was such a fun date. Thank you for asking me！
And thank you for going on a date with me, I guess.
I fell for you all over again... Just kidding▼
That much!? I'm glad I tried hard...
Since we started dating, you've given me so many memories... but this one will be extra special.
Let's keep making lots of special ones.
Thank you for inviting me to your place.
Well, it's not much of a room to invite someone to. It was a bit messy, too.
Hehe, then shall I clean it next time I come？
It's fine, I'll tidy it up myself.
I went to your room, right？ Do you rearrange it often？
Not really. Sometimes I just move stuff around.
Good. Because I like the feel of that room.
Really？ If you like it, I'm happy.
Whenever I go to your room, leaving is hard.
It's not that. I get so comfortable that I don't want to go home...
(I can't exactly say 'You don't have to go home'...)
You came over to my house, right？ Things got a little hectic afterward.
No, Papa was asking all kinds of questions about you, and Mama got mad at him. Said it wasn't his place to pry.
Hmm... I owe your mom one.
How was it... it was fun？
Then I'm glad. Not anytime... but come again.
Yeah, thanks. I'll come visit again.
I had a great time relaxing in ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s room. Thanks for inviting me.
Yes... Mama said to come again too.
I see. I'll have to thank her properly someday.
You know, I wanted to thank you for letting me use your shower...
It's fine, it would've been rough if you hadn't.
While I was in the shower... thinking you were right there... I got nervous.
The place we went to on our date was delicious♪
Yeah. Shall we go there on our next date too？
Well, there are dishes I haven't tried yet... but I'd like to try other places too...
Tough call. I'll think about it too.
I loved the place we went to on our date. Did you take me there because you knew I would？
Ah, a secret？ Either way, I have to thank you.
Look forward to our next date too.
Thank you for taking me somewhere so delicious.
When the food is good, it lifts your mood too, right？
True. Picking the restaurant is an important part of a date...
Hey, what are you doing right now？
Talking on the phone with my girlfriend.
That's not what I meant... geez. It's embarrassing when you suddenly say that.
What are you doing right now？
Me too. And then suddenly your face popped into my head...
I see... I can't show you my face, but I'll keep you company on the phone.
I'm taking a break from studying. ...It's nice that we can call each other for no reason like this.
Yeah. No need to hold back, call anytime.
No, nothing. I just wanted to hear your voice a little...
Haha, if my voice is good enough, you can have as much as you want.
Are you crying？ Did something happen？
Mm... thank you, I'm okay. I was reading a sad story and started crying... Hearing your voice calmed me down.
Out of nowhere？ Um... sorry, nothing comes to mind right away.
Hehe, sorry. I just wanted to hear your voice, so it didn't matter what you talked about.
Oh, you could have said so from the start...
Sorry for calling so late. I can't sleep, somehow... were you up？
I was up. You go to bed early, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Wouldn't it be fine to stay up a little longer？
That's not true, staying up late is bad for you... I have to try hard to sleep properly.
Maybe trying so hard is what keeps you awake. Don't force it, just relax.
I called because I couldn't sleep. Even in bed, I just keep thinking about things...
If you want, I'll keep you company？ I'll be up a while longer.
...Thank you. Hearing your voice calmed me down. I think I can sleep now.
I see, good. If you can't sleep, call me anytime.
I'm having trouble falling asleep tonight... I wanted to talk to you. Am I bothering you？
Not at all. Um, shall I sing you a lullaby？
Hehe, I'm happy, but it's okay. Just hearing your voice was enough.
Just this？ If there's anything else I can do, just say so.
Hey, it's almost time for bed, right？
It's this late already... ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s going to bed now too, right？
Yes. I wanted to say good night before that. Good night.
So that's why... Good night, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's time for bed, right？ ...Good night.
When you live alone, there's no one to say good night to, right？ So now sleep tight？
Come to think of it, that's true. Thanks.
I have to sleep. Getting to hear your voice at the end of the day... feels like a luxury.
I'm happy I got to talk with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ before bed too.
Let's talk lots tomorrow too, okay？ Good night.
I did a lot of practice on my own before my bath today, so I think I'll fall asleep fast.
I see. Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
Thank you, I'm fine. Well, good night.
I heard from a friend there might be a pop quiz soon.
I see... I'd better review properly. Thanks.
You're welcome. Well, I'm going to bed. Good night.
Good night. I'll study a little before bed.
Mama taught me a new dish today.
Oh, maybe you'll make it for me？
Once I can make it properly delicious. Ah, I should go to bed. Don't stay up late either？
When ▲高嶺＊＊▲ calls, I'd wake up even from a dead sleep.
That makes me happy... You're not just exaggerating because you're half asleep, right？
Good morning. Did you get up okay？ I'm all ready for the morning.
This is Manaka Takane's morning call service. Are you properly awake？
That woke me right up！ I'm full of energy now！
Thanks. Today's going to be a good day！
Good morning. Let's do our best today.
Yeah, thanks for the morning call.
Good morning. Sorry for calling so early. I wondered if you were up.
I was up. Sounds like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has been up for a while？
At my house, everyone's usually up by this time.
Early to bed, early to rise... the Takane family sure is healthy.
Good morning. Your voice sounds a little weak. Sleepy？
Geez, no going back to sleep, okay？ ...Wake. Up▼
You haven't been coming to club lately. Are you feeling sick？
It's not that, I just haven't been able to make it for one reason or another...
I don't want you to push yourself, but I want to play tennis with you...
Got it, thanks. I'll try to come as much as I can.
I was happy to hear your voice. See you.
Good night... I hope I dream about you... Just kidding▼
It's me. I want to talk, is that okay？
I wanted to apologize. It was my fault. Sorry.
Okay... I'm sorry too, I couldn't be honest.
It's fine. So let's call this making up. Okay？
Yes. While we were fighting, it was so hard... We'll have to make up for it on our next date, okay？
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
We were both to blame back then. We were both being stubborn.
Maybe so... Hey, I don't want things to stay like this.
Me neither. Let's make up, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Right, let's make up. Next time we meet, we'll both be smiling. Okay？
Let's make time for just the two of us soon, okay？ Bye...
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
I've been thinking since then... I wasn't in the wrong, was I？
Um... that doesn't mean I'm saying it was ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s fault...
No... I was being stubborn too. I... want to make up with you too.
Right, let's make up. That's what I called to say.
What a relief... I'll call you again. Bye...
(Looks like she's in a better mood now...)
Ah, there's a voicemail. From ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's Manaka. Happy birthday！ Manaka loves you▼
I couldn't reach you, but I put my feelings into a voicemail. Well... see you.
(I wanted to hear that in person！)
It's Manaka. Today is our special anniversary...
I wish I could have talked to you... See you, bye.
(She went to the trouble of calling, and I missed it...)
Hello, it's Manaka. Happy New Year.
Too bad I couldn't give you my New Year's greeting in person... see you.
It's Manaka. I was hoping we could meet now... too bad. I'll ask again. Bye.
Um... it's Manaka. I thought it'd be nice if we could meet, but it was sudden, wasn't it？ Sorry for calling out of the blue. Bye.
Hello, it's me. I wanted to see you, but I couldn't get through... I was unlucky today, but I'll call again. Bye-bye.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... she called and I missed it. My bad.)
It's Manaka. I called to ask you on a date, but couldn't get through. How's your schedule？ Well, see you.
Hello, it's Manaka. Would you like to go out together sometime？ If you feel like it, let me know.
(A date, huh... what should I do？)
Hello, it's Manaka. Your girlfriend is in the mood to go on a date soon... Just kidding. Think about it. Bye.
It's Manaka. I don't really have a reason... I just wanted to talk a little. I'll call again, okay？
(What's up with her？ Maybe I'll call her...)
